name: verification_seal
rule: data_tables = written + context. digest = sha256 of the canonical JSON {schema, name, tables: sorted data_tables}. Prose and sites do not enter the digest.
derived_from: the two write surfaces the code itself declares and enforces at run time: the verifier job proves its login holds privilege on exactly verification_job.VERIFIER_WRITE_TABLES (and none on BUILDER_TABLES) before it writes, and the sealer proves its login holds exactly seal_flow.SEALER_WRITE_ALLOWED; every other Cloud Run job or script of the verification and sealing path is read-only on these relations. Re-derived by tests/test_backup_v5_century_scopes.py (V1) from those constants, and equal to the J5S pack's derive_scope.py output.

context.why: NOT written by the verification or sealing jobs (only scripts/migrate.ts at deploy). Kept so the restore proof can state the scratch schema is at the same migration set (as in the small_test scope).

guarded_children_note: none declared: a delete/update referential action from a written table to a table outside the data set is refused BY NAME at capture time (backup_v5_small_test_job.scoped_catalog), so an unreviewed child fails closed instead of being assumed away.
builder_tables_note: verification_job.BUILDER_TABLES, copied for the reader: the VERIFIER login holds no write on them. kala_gochara_publication is also listed as written because the SEALER login (a different principal) updates four of its columns.
